note: The pins of the three SpriteFusion command-line tools the art pipeline runs. Data, reviewed in a diff: tools/toolchain.py reads it and nothing else decides a version. A change here is a deliberate upgrade of a tool. 'sha256' lists the accepted binary hashes of this build host (macOS arm64); it is printed always and enforced only with KONCLUI_TOOLCHAIN_SHA256=enforce, because a rebuild of the same commit gives another hash. The palette-snapper hash is of a build from a LOCAL CHECKOUT of the pinned commit (cargo install from a local path, recorded in ~/.cargo/.crates2.json), not of one made by the documented 'cargo install --git ... --rev' command, which can give another hash: re-measure and list it when that command is run on the build host.
